summary: DHT Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching press releases: one announcing a newbuild Very Large Crude Carrier (VLCC) from Hanwha Ocean for delivery August 2028, and one about a new $250 million revolving credit facility. The newbuilding is a routine capital expenditure financed through cash flow and mortgage debt, with no acquisition, divestiture, or structural change. The credit facility is ordinary corporate borrowing. Neither press release triggers a special situation; the filing is a standard foreign private issuer update.
